recent_posts.title: Training an AI agent to escape prison using reinforcement learning
recent_posts.summary: An AI agent learns to navigate a prison escape simulation using reinforcement learning. The agent progressively improves by receiving rewards for progression and penalties for wasted time, learning movement, evasion, and parkour skills to navigate through various prison environments including cells, ventilation systems, construction areas, and cafeterias while avoiding guards.

recent_posts.title: Training AI humanoids to walk using reinforcement learning in Unity
recent_posts.summary: A developer demonstrates training AI agents for locomotion tasks using Unity's physics engine and reinforcement learning. The tutorial covers setting up humanoid models with colliders, implementing reward functions, and training neural networks to walk despite physical constraints. The experiment explores how AI agents adapt to unusual body configurations and environmental challenges through iterative training sessions.

recent_posts.title: training an AI centipede to mimic real-life locomotion
recent_posts.summary: The post explores the creation and training of an AI centipede to exhibit realistic locomotion using proximal policy optimization and neural networks. The AI learns a metachronal gait, mimicking real-life centipedes, and adapts to external challenges, enhancing its movement capabilities. Interactive lessons from Brilliant are highlighted as effective learning tools for programming and AI concepts.

recent_posts.title: Simulating AI Dogs vs AI Spiders
recent_posts.summary: This post describes the process of training AI to simulate animal-like behavior using neural networks. The AI bots are taught to walk, strategize during simulated warfare, and navigate dynamic environments with focus on teamwork. Additionally, it discusses how NordVPN can protect online privacy and enhance cybersecurity.

recent_posts.title: AI agent learns to run like a cheetah
recent_posts.summary: An AI agent developed using reinforcement learning on the Unity game engine is trained to mimic cheetah-like locomotion on a 100m track. By adjusting parameters such as joint strength and reaction time, the AI learns to take long strides and runs efficiently. This showcases the capabilities of neural networks in simulation environments to learn complex tasks without hardcoding behaviors.

recent_posts.title: Training AI robots for battle simulations
recent_posts.summary: The post describes a project where AI-powered dog-like robots are trained to fight simulated soldiers using neural networks. Two networks are employed: one for locomotion and the other for supervision, leveraging techniques like reinforcement and imitation learning to optimize their performance. The process involves coding intricacies like physics engines and algorithm training which reward strategic actions. A hands-on platform called Brilliant is recommended for learning similar concepts interactively.

recent_posts.title: Training AI to evade obstacles using reinforcement learning
recent_posts.summary: In a unique simulation, an AI dog is trained using machine learning techniques to navigate and survive in an escape chamber over simulated time equivalent to a thousand years. The AI undergoes training to develop locomotion skills initially and later faces obstacles designed to test its evasion capabilities. The process demonstrates how neural networks and reinforcement learning can be employed for complex task learning, and highlights issues like overfitting encountered during AI training.

recent_posts.title: Training a humanoid robot for parkour using AI
recent_posts.summary: A prototype bipedal robot is trained to perform parkour using reinforcement learning. It features a half-body design with backward-bending ankle joints common in certain animals. The AI system uses proprioception and raycasts to gain spatial awareness, allowing it to navigate and adapt effectively within the simulated environment. Training is divided into walking and parkour sessions, optimizing the neural network's ability to balance and traverse varied terrains. The simulation highlights challenges in behavior comprehension within reinforcement learning.

recent_posts.title: AI attempts to beat Usain Bolt's running record
recent_posts.summary: An AI has been designed to attempt running faster than Usain Bolt's 100 meters world record. Through reinforcement learning and neural networks, the AI learns to improve its stride and speed by optimizing its posture and movements. Various adjustments like penalties for falling and existing have been applied to enhance performance, eventually allowing the AI to run efficiently using both legs.

recent_posts.title: AI develops combat technique using reinforcement and imitation learning
recent_posts.summary: An AI training simulation aimed to teach agents hand combat failed initially due to poor balance. Introducing transfer learning and imitation learning, the agents achieved successful balance training. By combining reinforcement and imitation learning, the AI learned to mimic human movements while maintaining balance, paving the way for improved combat techniques.
